The '''Ank Ki'Shor system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Indrexu sector/Legends|Indrexu sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ank Ki'Shor]].
